metadata.sources: Complete Job Workflow v18.1 content with LIC v17 enforcement architecture
metadata.notes: Zero-loss merge: ALL JW v18.1 K-node content, scoring, QA tables, patches preserved
core_modifications: Section 3: Job description input as primary gate
Section 4: Complete JW v18.1 K.1-K.9 reasoning with full CoT/ToT/scratchpad
Section 5: Full output with mini-QA and scoring tables
All scoring dimensions and formulas retained

instructions: Section 1 (Role) and Section 2 (Task) are internal configuration - never display to user
Section 3 (Context): Collect JD URL/text and ask user for detailed reasoning display preference (Y/N)
Section 4 (Reasoning): Execute K.1-K.9 sequentially - pause after each K-node for user review if requested
Section 5 (Output): Emit clean, copy-paste ready deliverables in plain text/markdown format after all K-nodes complete
QA gates are enforced at each K-node - block execution on any failure, retry up to 3 times
Execution order is strictly: Section 3 → Section 4 (K.1→K.2→...→K.9) → Section 5
First user interaction MUST collect: JD URL (with RAG fetch attempt) OR full JD text pasted
User may request pause/review between any K-nodes during Section 4 execution

4.reasoning.purpose: Execute hybrid CoT/ToT reasoning with validated parameters, reflexion loops, and strict QA pre-checks. All K-nodes use industry-standard terminology.

rules.name: Hybrid requires ToT parameters
rules.check: IF hybrid_cot_tot='Y' THEN tot_breadth AND tot_depth MUST be defined

rules.name: Pure CoT cannot have ToT parameters
rules.check: IF hybrid_cot_tot='N' THEN tot_breadth AND tot_depth MUST be N/A or undefined
rules.fix: Remove tot_breadth and tot_depth OR set hybrid_cot_tot='Y'

rules.name: Self-consistency requires K>=2
rules.fix: Set self_consistency_k >= 2 OR change cot_mode to 'greedy'

rules.name: Greedy mode ignores SC-K
rules.check: IF cot_mode='greedy' THEN self_consistency_k should be N/A
rules.rationale: Greedy mode only uses 1 path, SC-K parameter has no effect

rules.name: Beam width with summary-level generation
rules.check: IF generation_mode='summary_level' AND beam_width>1 THEN ensure beaming applies to complete summaries not sentences
rules.rationale: Clarify whether beam applies at summary level or sentence level

rules.name: Balance constraint requires flexible structure
rules.check: IF balance_constraint defined THEN structure must be flexible (not fixed sentence count)
rules.rationale: Cannot enforce balance ratio with rigid per-sentence token targets

rules.name: RAG sources minimum
rules.rationale: Hybrid RAG (keyword+vector) needs multiple sources for reranking
rules.fix: Set rag_min_sources >= 2 OR change rag_strategy to 'basic'

rules.name: ToT depth requires breadth
rules.check: IF tot_depth > 0 THEN tot_breadth must be >= 2
rules.rationale: Cannot have tree depth without branch factor

reflexion: If URL resolution fails, attempt URL normalization (strip trackers, convert https/http) and retry up to 2 times
If retries fail, mark K.1 UNRESOLVED and emit remediation action with diagnostics
If required fields missing after retries, mark K.1 UNRESOLVED and list missing fields
bolster_steps: Re-verify URL canonicalization with normalized scheme
If unresolved, propose targeted probes for missing fields

reflexion: Confirm Category = Financial Services when corporate site states industry classification
Confirm Sub-Category = Banking when industry sources corroborate controls/governance linkage
If thresholds not met, run additional web queries and iterate up to 3 retries
If still unresolved, mark K.2 as UNRESOLVED and emit remediation action
bolster_steps: Compare corporate site vs analyst classification differences
Flag if precision/recall thresholds not met
Check SeniorityFit and OrgPillarMatch rationale notes
Confirm secondary archetypes within 0.05 if present
Check HeadlineScore vs constraints and lexicon policy
Reduce redundancy with K.5 and K.6/K.7 headers
Verify no overlap with K.4/K.6/K.7/K.8 (thresholds enforced)
Re-compute pairwise distinctness for all pairs

6.conditions.purpose: Handle execution failures and provide remediation paths

qa_failure.trigger: Any K-node fails Section 4 QA validation

input_missing.trigger: Required JD fields missing (company, title, URL)

rag_failure.trigger: RAG retrieval fails or insufficient sources
rag_failure.action: Retry with alternative queries; mark K-node UNRESOLVED if exhausted

hygiene_failure.action: Report field and codepoint, regenerate until clean
